    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_MPOO" name="MPOO" processRef="Process_MPOO"/>

                      sourceRef="Task_SendDismissal" targetRef="StartEvent_ReceiveDismissal"
                      messageRef="Message_Dismissal"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_MPOO" name="MPOO reviews dismissal" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewDismissal" name="Review dismissal"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" name="Dismissal outcome"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Opposed" name="Dismissal opposed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Confirmed" name="Dismissal confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_ReceiveDismissal" targetRef="Task_ReviewDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_2" sourceRef="Task_ReviewDismissal" targetRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" targetRef="Task_OpposeDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_DismissalOutcome" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_5" sourceRef="Task_OpposeDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Opposed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MPOO_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDismissal" targetRef="EndEvent_Confirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
